profile.summary: Lincoln Families is a nonprofit youth and family services agency in Oakland, founded in 1883. It runs school-based and community-based programs, including mental health services, foster care support, early childhood programs and family resource centers, in Alameda and Contra Costa Counties. Its HOPE program (Helping Open Pathways to Education) offers student counseling, family engagement, teacher consultation and whole-school supports.

review.notes: Lincoln Families' site confirms the HOPE program (school-based counseling), the 150 Linden St Oakland headquarters, contact details and EIN 94-1156501, which ProPublica lists as the 501(c)(3) 'Lincoln' in Oakland. The summary is neutral and consistent with the sources, though no page names OUSD explicitly.
